newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM cut by Salomon to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM cut by Salomon to buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it downgraded International Business Machines Corp to buy from strong buy.
-- said IBM hit Salomon's target price of $91 (on a post-split basis) on May 28.
-- said IBM's shares have gained 25 percent since Salomon upgraded the company on January 28, compared to an 11 percent increase in the S&P 500.
-- said it remains positive about IBM's long-term fundamentals and believes the shares could rise to $100 over the next nine months.
-- said IBM is on track to deliver mid-double-digit earnings per share growth over the next two to three years.
-- said IBM's earnings could be driven by high single-digit revenue growth led by services, OEM business and PCs.
-- IBM shares were off 1-7/8 to 88 in morning trading.
